subtitulo: Every change in the campaign, newest first. Each one can be undone.

vacio.desc: Whenever something is created, edited or deleted (by hand or through proposals), it will be recorded here.

deshacer.aviso: The inverse change will be applied: what was added ({{a}}) will be removed and what was removed ({{e}}) will be restored. The undo is recorded as a new change, so it can be reverted too.
